authority_scope: execution-contract authoring only; no microdiagnostic executed, no route qualified, no receiver effect or Stage32 MAIN credit granted

source_locks.role: exact EFF/MB receiver identities and field-model semantics

required_fields: nonempty exact Stage32 MB subset T
exact map proving every t in T lands in source branch variety B
exact receiver condition K satisfied by every t in T
object/model/field compatibility between source B+K system and FM-GEO-S-MB
quantifier compatibility with no silent Q-rationality narrowing
exhaustive zero-factor/pole/infinity/degenerate classification for the tested joint system
exact_adapter.known_open_issue: S34-W03 is stated using B(Q) intersect K(Q), while the frozen EX5 MB receiver is geometric and EX5 adds no Q-rationality restriction. An adapter must either prove the attacked T is exactly within the source rational-point scope for source-valid reasons or provide an equally authoritative field-general version; otherwise transfer fails.

bounded_unit.instruction: For S34-W03 against the single frozen MB meta-receiver, fill the seven adapter fields from exact sources and stop at the first unsatisfied field. Do not run residue enumeration or widen to EFF/V6/O210/Q602.
bounded_unit.max_target_scope: one exact nonempty MB subset T if such a subset can be source-defined

expected_observable.failure_form: first named unsatisfied adapter field with exact source mismatch

execution_contracts.success_predicate: All seven adapter fields are source-complete for a nonempty T and the Q/geometric scope issue is resolved without adding a receiver condition absent from EX5-01. This yields ROUTE_SURVIVES_PREFLIGHT_WITH_EXACT_NEW_PREDICATE only; it does not yet grant a receiver effect.
execution_contracts.failure_predicate: Any required adapter field is unprovable from exact sources, especially a rational-point-only source conclusion applied to the geometric MB population without a population-preserving bridge. Record ROUTE_BLOCKED_BY_NAMED_MISSING_ADAPTER.

input.new_input_required: source-valid population-complete effective-cone/fixed-component theorem or certificate

required_fields: the theorem/certificate is valid on FM-GEO-S divisor classes D
it is total on the attacked complete class/block rather than on a sampled member
it returns INEFFECTIVE or D=F+M with F nonzero and forced
the remaining M lies in a strictly smaller well-founded receiver measure
descent leaves have exact complete interpretation in the frozen EFF receiver
exact_adapter.known_open_issue: No source-valid population-complete effective-cone/fixed-component theorem is bound at EX5-06.

bounded_unit.instruction: Choose one exact complete frozen numerical row/block deterministically from EX5-01, treat effectivity conditionally on numerical survival, and test whether the same source-valid forced-component predicate plus strict descent measure can be certified for every class in that block without assuming an actual curve.
bounded_unit.deterministic_seed_rule: lowest-degree OPEN residual numerical row/block compatible with the theorem once a theorem is source-bound

expected_observable.success_form: source-located total fixed-component predicate and well-founded strict descent certificate for the complete test block
expected_observable.failure_form: named missing theorem, non-forced component, non-total predicate, or non-well-founded descent

execution_contracts.success_predicate: The complete test block receives a replayable source-valid strict reduction contract. This is preflight survival only unless a previously open EFF receiver subset is actually removed/reduced with completeness.
execution_contracts.failure_predicate: No source-valid total theorem/certificate exists, a component is only heuristic/member-specific, or the descent measure is not strict/well-founded. Record ROUTE_BLOCKED_BY_NAMED_MISSING_INPUT or ROUTE_DISPROVED_ON_REQUIRED_INTERFACE.

input.new_input_required: source-valid equigeneric/singularity codimension theorem plus exact complete-linear-system dimension

required_fields: exact complete-linear-system dimension for every class in the attacked complete block
exact genus defect required by the target geometric genus
source-valid lower codimension bound for every singularity type allowed on FM-GEO-S in that block
population completeness of the allowed singularity-type inventory
strict codimension > dimension implication applied to the complete block
exact_adapter.known_open_issue: No source-valid equigeneric codimension theorem covering all allowed singularity types is bound at EX5-06.

bounded_unit.instruction: On one deterministic complete frozen row/block, source-lock the linear-system dimension and genus-defect sides, enumerate theorem-covered singularity types, and test whether a valid strict codimension inequality can be stated for the entire block.
bounded_unit.deterministic_seed_rule: lowest-degree OPEN residual numerical row/block for which both dimension and theorem inputs are exact

expected_observable.success_form: source-complete strict population-wide codimension inequality for one complete test block
expected_observable.failure_form: missing dimension source, incomplete singularity inventory, invalid codimension theorem, or non-strict inequality

execution_contracts.success_predicate: A complete block has a replayable strict codimension inequality under exact allowed-singularity semantics. Receiver effect is granted only if that inequality excludes an exact previously open EFF subset.
execution_contracts.failure_predicate: Any dimension/codimension input is unbound, singularity coverage is incomplete, or the inequality is not strict on the complete block. Record a typed blocker; this does not exhaust EHS globally.
